full_prompt_en: A square screen-print-like illustration shows a tightly grouped line of uniformed figures against a vivid red background. Two large figures fill the foreground, one at the left and one just right of center, both facing forward with serious expressions. Each wears a pale blue-gray cap carrying a red star and a dark red-brown jacket with sharply cut lapels and collar. Their faces are rendered in flat pale peach planes edged by thick black shadows under the cap brims, along the noses, and below the chins. Behind them, smaller capped figures form a dense second row. Only portions of their faces and shoulders are visible between the front pair and near the far right edge. A long dark vertical object rises along the left edge, and a few other narrow shapes interrupt the red field behind the group. The upper half contains generous uninterrupted red, touched by broad slightly darker brushlike streaks. The figures' shoulders and clothing occupy the lower half in overlapping blocks of black, rust red, and gray-blue. Their repeated caps and upright postures create a strong rhythm, while size differences establish a shallow depth. Light is graphic rather than naturalistic: pale face planes and cap tops are set against decisive black shadow shapes, with almost no gradual modeling or cast shadow in the red background. Some edges show coarse print texture and slight irregularity rather than perfectly smooth vector fills. No words or slogans appear in the selected panel. The overall composition is confrontational and compact, using repetition, frontal gaze, stark value blocks, and saturated red to create the force of a poster image.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形丝网印刷感插画呈现一队紧密排列的制服人物，背景是鲜艳红色。两个较大人物填满前景，一人在左，一人在中央偏右，都正面朝前，神情严肃。两人都戴带红星的浅蓝灰帽，穿深红棕外套，翻领和衣领被利落切出。面部由平坦浅桃色面组成，帽檐下、鼻旁和下巴下面被厚黑影勾出。后方更小的戴帽人物构成密集第二排，面孔与肩膀只在前排两人之间和最右边缘局部露出。一个长深色竖物沿左边缘升起，另有几道窄形打断人群后的红色区域。上半幅保留大片不中断的红，带更暗一些的宽刷痕。人物肩部和衣物在下半幅重叠成黑、锈红和灰蓝色块。反复的帽形和直立姿态形成强节奏，尺度差异建立浅纵深。光是图形化的而非自然写实：浅脸色面与帽顶对照坚决的黑影形，几乎没有缓慢塑形或红背景里的投影。部分边缘有粗印刷肌理和轻微不规则，而非完美平滑矢量填色。选定画面没有词语或标语。整体构图逼近而紧凑，以重复、正面凝视、强明度块和饱和红色构成海报般力量。
style_prompt_en: Screen-print-like graphic painting uses flat saturated red as a dominant field against black, pale blue-gray, and warm peach blocks. Thick contour and shadow shapes simplify volume into decisive planes, with very little soft gradient. Repeated upright forms create collective rhythm, while two or three larger foreground accents make the hierarchy immediate. Negative space above the dense lower grouping strengthens the bold color field. Small coarse-print speckles and brushlike irregularities keep the surface from feeling mechanically vectorized. Lighting is encoded through cutout light and dark shapes rather than realistic illumination; sharp edge contrasts carry the form. Limited color and shallow overlap make the image readable at a distance. The overall effect is assertive, graphic, and poster-like, with repetition and disciplined value separation supplying impact.
style_prompt_zh: 丝网印刷感的图形绘画用平坦饱和红作为主色域，对照黑、浅蓝灰与暖桃色块。厚轮廓和阴影形把体积简化成坚决色面，几乎没有柔渐层。重复直立形建立群体节奏，两三个较大前景重音让层级立即清楚。密集下部群块上方的留白加强大胆色域。细小粗印刷颗粒和刷痕般不规则让表面不显机械矢量化。光通过剪纸式明暗形编码，而非写实照明；锐利边缘对照承载形体。有限颜色和浅层重叠使图像远看也容易辨读。整体效果强势、图形化、像海报，靠重复与有纪律的明度分离产生冲击。
theme_en: A tightly grouped line of uniformed figures against a vivid red background
theme_zh: 鲜红背景前紧密排列的一队制服人物
name: Wang Guangyi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
